entities.summary: Haile Selassie I, a notable figure in the history of Ethiopia, associated with Modern Ethiopian Empire (1916–1936). Preceded by Haile Selassie's Rise and Modernisation and Treaty of Wuchale. Their legacy influenced Italian Invasion Ethiopia 1935 and Italian Invasion and Occupation.
